ask: Should I open these four issues in Linear: scale test for waiting files, safe local database changes, batch time limit test, and tall-script text check?
problem: The old app, version 2, had many fixes. Nobody had checked whether the new app could repeat those faults.
found: Thirteen of seventeen fault kinds are already handled. Four are not. The worst: the phone's local database has no version, and one old step deletes unsent work. The others lack tests for many waiting files, batch time limits, and tall scripts.
changed: Nothing people see. I added one report to the docs folder, with a table of all seventeen kinds and the four open faults, most serious first. The draft pull request is open and not merged.
why: I read the old app's history without copying any code. I read about 45 fixes in full and sorted the rest by their titles, so a fault hidden under a vague title could be missed. I checked the new app by reading its code and tests, not by running it.
touches: Nothing else. Each recommended issue is small. The database one may need a new entry in the decision log when built.

pictures.label: Faults that can come back, most serious first
